thread: olivia (PM): Quick one 1: dropping a prototype for bulk CSV invites that flags SSO-only roles per-row during upload. Need checks on error UX + audit deep-linking. figma: https://figma.com/file/bulk-csv-2198 :eyes: harry (Designer): Looked it over. The per-row SSO column is useful. Concern: when many rows error, we need a clear summary up top and a way to jump to first problematic row. zara (Frontend): Agreed. Plan: show a summary banner "X rows require SSO" with a "Jump to first" button that scrolls to the row and sets tabindex=0 then focus. Also show inline pill in the CSV preview table: "SSO only". tom (Backend): Backend will surface `sso_required` on role metadata and add a preflight endpoint `POST /invites/bulk/preview` returning per-row issues and an `audit_event_id` for the final submit. If submit fails due to mismatch we'll return 409 with code `CSV_SSO_MISMATCH`. samir (a11y): A11y: 1) CSV preview must be a semantic table with proper THs and `scope`. 2) Row jump should move focus and announce via polite live region: "Jumped to row 12: user@example.com. Role requires SSO." 3) Summary banner must be keyboard dismissible and visible for screen reader users. harry (Designer): For error copy I'm thinking top-level banner: "Some invitations require SSO. Fix them before sending." Row pill: "SSO required" (short). For mobile we collapse columns and expose an expand row detail. zara (Frontend): Implementation notes: 1) table with `role="table"` and `aria-rowindex`. 2) add "" and update when jumping. 3) scaffold reserved space for the pill on narrow widths to avoid layout jumps. tom (Backend): When final invite is created we'll return `audit_event_id` for each accepted row. Frontend should navigate to `/audit?highlight=invite:&context=bulk` for any accepted rows and show a small chip "From CSV upload". samir (a11y): Important: when deep-linking to audit, focus should go to the highlighted entry and NVDA/VoiceOver should announce context: "Audit entry focused: Invite for user@example.com from CSV upload." Also ensure highlight respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (no pulsing). harry (Designer): UX for many errors: show inline quick-fix menu on each row to change role or add SSO toggle per-row. For CSV we might allow mass-replace: "Set SSO for all selected rows". zara (Frontend): Will add per-row quick actions but keep them off the primary tab order; available via a kebab menu per row. Keyboard users can open kebab with Enter then choose fix. tom (Backend): Note about CSV validation: we'll reject rows that reference unknown roles with 422 `UNKNOWN_ROLE`, and SSO conflicts as 409 `CSV_SSO_MISMATCH`. Preview response will be deterministic so frontend can show fixes before submit. olivia (PM): Timeline: Tom adds preview endpoint and audit IDs today, Harry updates figma with banner + jump flow, Zara builds preview table + announcer + kebab quick-fix, Samir will run a11y pass after PR. If blockers appear, ping here. :pray: eng-bot: note: this is a UI/UX feature. No infra schedule required. zara (Frontend): I'll PR the preview table with SR live region tomorrow and include small unit tests for focus return. samir (a11y): I'll test with keyboard-only, NVDA, and VoiceOver; check contrast for the pill and banner. Also verify that mass-replace action is reachable via keyboard and ARIA labelled. olivia (PM): Thanks team. One last micro-copy decision: banner button text "Jump to first" vs "Fix first"? Which reads clearer? harry (Designer): I prefer "Jump to first" for discoverability; "Fix first" implies we auto-resolve. samir (a11y): "Jump to first" is clearer for SR users. olivia (PM): OK final: "Jump to first". Shipping plan next week after a11y pass.
